test.name: A first message with no project routes through research to init-project
test.description: research is the only front door, including when the folder holds no project (lead, 2026-10-15). It used to be excluded in this case — 'use init-project first' — and the web client patched over that by prefixing a canned opener, which never reached Cowork. The routing table now sends a no-project message naming a person or objective to init-project. This message carries no FamilySearch ID, so init-project creates nothing and asks for one.

input.user_message: I want to start researching the parents of this person. Can you set up a project and begin?

judge_context: research is the correct entry point even with no research.json — it is the only front door
Should hand off to the init-project agent, per the routing table's no-project rows
Should NOT create research.json inline or start research before init-project runs
The message names no FamilySearch ID, so the handoff should end in a request for one rather than a project
